cigarHint.hr: Most su kakao, crema i gorčina; biraj puniju Habano ili maduro cigaru i drži vodu na stolu.
cigarHint.en: The bridge is cocoa, crema and bitterness; pick a fuller Habano or maduro and keep water on the table.

notes.hr: Klasični bar espresso s udjelom robuste: gust, gorak, s debelom cremom. Tamno prženje gubi voćnu kiselost i ostavlja kakao, pepeo i zemlju. Nosi maduro i punu Habano cigaru; blagi Connecticut ostaje ispod šalice.
notes.en: Classic bar espresso with robusta: dense, bitter, thick crema. Dark roast drops fruit acidity and leaves cocoa, ash and earth. It carries maduro and a full Habano; a mild Connecticut sits under the cup.

cigarHint.hr: Voće i karamela prate srednju Habano cigaru; maduro je pretežak za ovu slatkoću.
cigarHint.en: Fruit and caramel follow a medium Habano; maduro is too heavy for this sweetness.

notes.hr: Specialty espresso od 100 % arabice, srednje pržen. Slađi je i voćniji od barske mješavine, s manje gorčine u aftertasteu. Ide uz srednje Habano i Cameroon cigare; maduro ga lako pregazi.
notes.en: Specialty espresso from 100% arabica, medium roast. Sweeter and fruitier than a bar blend, with less bitter aftertaste. It suits medium Habano and Cameroon; maduro easily overruns it.

cigarHint.hr: Kratka šalica, kratka cigara: mali gutljaji uz robusto ili belicoso, ne uz churchill.
cigarHint.en: Short cup, short cigar: small sips with a robusto or belicoso, not a Churchill.

notes.hr: Kraća ekstrakcija, manji volumen, veća slatkoća u odnosu na obični espresso. Gorčina ostaje, ali je kraća. Mali gutljaji uz kratku, jaku cigaru; dugi Churchill traži doppio ili french press.
notes.en: Shorter extraction, smaller volume, more sweetness than a regular espresso. Bitterness stays, but it is briefer. Small sips with a short, strong cigar; a long Churchill wants a doppio or a french press.

cigarHint.hr: Volumen šalice prati dugu, punu cigaru; ritam je gutljaj na trećinu, ne na svaki dim.
cigarHint.en: Cup volume follows a long, full cigar; sip once per third, not on every puff.

notes.hr: Dva espressa u jednoj šalici: volumen i kofein za dugu sesiju. Gorčina i kakao drže ritam kroz zadnju trećinu cigare. Standard u cigar loungeu uz punu Habano ili maduro cigaru.
notes.en: Two espressos in one cup: volume and caffeine for a long session. Bitterness and cocoa keep pace through the cigar's final third. Lounge standard with a full Habano or maduro.

cigarHint.hr: Gustoća i začin vole zemljanu, jaku cigaru; šećer u džezvi lijepi maduro, ne Shade.
cigarHint.en: Density and spice like an earthy, strong cigar; sugar in the pot glues maduro, not Shade.

notes.hr: Fino mljevena kava kuha se u džezvi i pije s talogom. Gusta je, mutna i začinska; šećer se dodaje u loncu, ne u šalici. Tradicionalni par zemljanim, jakim cigarama; sa šećerom postaje most prema maduru.
notes.en: Very fine grind simmered in a cezve and drunk with the grounds. Thick, muddy, spicy; sugar goes in the pot, not the cup. Traditional with earthy, strong cigars; sweetened, it bridges to maduro.

cigarHint.hr: Kućni most uz srednju do punu cigaru; jači od filtera, pa Connecticut brzo utone.
cigarHint.en: A home bridge with a medium to full cigar; stronger than filter, so Connecticut sinks quickly.

notes.hr: Para gura vodu kroz mljevenu kavu na štednjaku. Jača je od filtera, mekša od pravog espressa, s kakaoom i blagom gorčinom. Kućni ritual uz srednju do punu cigaru, bez potrebe za strojem.
notes.en: Stovetop steam pushes water through the grounds. Stronger than filter, softer than true espresso, with cocoa and mild bitterness. A home ritual with a medium to full cigar, no machine required.

cigarHint.hr: Čajno tijelo traži najblaži Connecticut; jači dim briše jasmin prije nego se šalica ohladi.
cigarHint.en: Tea-like body wants the mildest Connecticut; stronger smoke wipes the jasmine before the cup cools.

notes.hr: Oprana Yirgacheffe, svijetlo prženje: jasmin, bergamot, čajno tijelo. Kiselost je visoka, TDS nizak. Samo uz najblaži Connecticut ili Cameroon; puna cigara prekrije šalicu prije trećeg dima.
notes.en: Washed Yirgacheffe, light roast: jasmine, bergamot, tea-like body. Acidity is high, TDS is low. Only with the mildest Connecticut or Cameroon; a full cigar covers the cup before the third puff.

cigarHint.hr: Kiselost čisti nepce uz Cameroon ili kratki Habano; maduro i ribiz se tuku.
cigarHint.en: Acidity cleanses the palate with Cameroon or a short Habano; maduro and currant fight.

notes.hr: Kenijski AA iz Nyerija: crni ribiz, limunska kiselost, vino u aftertasteu. Oprana obrada drži čašu čistom. Radi kao kontrast uz Cameroon ili kraći Habano; maduro i ova kiselost se tuku.
notes.en: Kenyan AA from Nyeri: blackcurrant, lemon acidity, a winey finish. Washed process keeps the cup clean. Works as contrast with Cameroon or a shorter Habano; maduro and this acidity fight.

cigarHint.hr: Srednje tijelo prati srednju Habano cigaru; svestran ulaz kad ne znaš koju kavu kuhati.
cigarHint.en: Medium body follows a medium Habano; a versatile start when you do not know which coffee to brew.

notes.hr: Huila, oprana, srednje prženje: karamela, crvena jabuka, orah. Najsvestranija filtar kava u katalogu. Prati srednje Habano cigare bez borbe; ni prelagana za Connecticut ni preslaba za umjereni maduro.
notes.en: Huila, washed, medium roast: caramel, red apple, nut. The most versatile filter coffee in the catalogue. It follows a medium Habano without a fight; neither too light for Connecticut nor too weak for a moderate maduro.

cigarHint.hr: Kakao i orah su najsigurniji most; maduro i Habano sjede, cvjetni Connecticut malo gubi.
cigarHint.en: Cocoa and nut are the safest bridge; maduro and Habano sit well, floral Connecticut loses a little.

notes.hr: Cerrado ili Santos, često natural: niska kiselost, kakao, lješnjak, karamela. To je zadana kava uz većinu cigara jer ništa ne vrišti. Maduro i Habano sjede mirno; cvjetni Connecticut gubi malo sjaja, ali prolazi.
notes.en: Cerrado or Santos, often natural: low acidity, cocoa, hazelnut, caramel. The default coffee with most cigars because nothing shouts. Maduro and Habano sit calmly; a floral Connecticut loses a little sparkle but still works.

cigarHint.hr: Začin i kakao vole Habano pokrov; Connecticut je preblag za vulkansku gustoću.
cigarHint.en: Spice and cocoa like a Habano wrapper; Connecticut is too mild for the volcanic density.

notes.hr: Vulkanski Antigua: kakao, začin, dašak dima uz srednje tijelo. Oprana obrada drži čistoću, a visina daje gustoću zrna. Voli Habano pokrov; Connecticut je preblag, oscuro pretežak.
notes.en: Volcanic Antigua: cocoa, spice, a whiff of smoke at medium body. Washed process keeps it clean; altitude densifies the bean. It likes a Habano wrapper; Connecticut is too mild, oscuro too heavy.

cigarHint.hr: Duhan, drvo i zemlja u šalici traže isti registar u dimu: Habano, ne Shade.
cigarHint.en: Tobacco, wood and earth in the cup want the same register in the smoke: Habano, not Shade.

notes.hr: Giling basah (poluprana) Sumatra: niska kiselost, sirupasto tijelo, duhan, drvo, zemlja, koža. Kava koja izgleda kao Habano cigara u šalici. Prirodan most uz zemljani dim; Connecticut ostaje bez posla.
notes.en: Giling basah (semi-washed) Sumatra: low acidity, syrupy body, tobacco, wood, earth, leather. The coffee that looks like a Habano cigar in a cup. A natural bridge with earthy smoke; Connecticut has nothing to do.

cigarHint.hr: Bez kiselosti, s duhanom: prirodan srodnik cigare; biraj Habano ili maduro.
cigarHint.en: No acidity, with tobacco: a natural relative of the cigar; pick Habano or maduro.

notes.hr: Monsunska obrada na Malabaru: zrno upija vlagu, kiselost nestaje, ostaju duhan, začin i kakao. Espresso iz ovog zrna ponaša se kao srodnik cigare. Traži Habano ili maduro, ne Shade.
notes.en: Monsoon process on the Malabar coast: the bean takes up humidity, acidity vanishes, tobacco, spice and cocoa remain. Espresso from this bean behaves like a relative of the cigar. It wants Habano or maduro, not Shade.

cigarHint.hr: Teritorijalni spoj uz kubansku cigaru; cafecito sa šećerom lijepi zadnju trećinu.
cigarHint.en: A terroir match with a Cuban cigar; sweet cafecito glues the final third.

notes.hr: Sierra Maestra, tamnije prženje: kakao, duhan, karamela, niska kiselost. Teritorijalni spoj uz kubansku cigaru drži se logike, ne magije. Cafecito sa šećerom je lokalni ritam; bez šećera ostaje suši most.
notes.en: Sierra Maestra, darker roast: cocoa, tobacco, caramel, low acidity. The terroir match with a Cuban cigar is logic, not magic. Sweet cafecito is the local pace; unsweetened it stays a drier bridge.

cigarHint.hr: Glatkoća voli elegantnu, srednje blagu cigaru bez mlijeka; maduro je pregrub.
cigarHint.en: Smoothness likes an elegant, mild-to-medium cigar without milk; maduro is too coarse.

notes.hr: Glatka, medena, niske gorčine; oprana, srednje prženje. Skupa je jer je zonirana i rijetka, ne jer je 'najbolja uz cigaru'. Posebna prilika uz elegantnu, srednje blagu cigaru (Davidoff, blaža Cohiba), bez mlijeka.
notes.en: Smooth, honeyed, low bitterness; washed, medium roast. It is expensive because it is zoned and scarce, not because it is 'best with a cigar'. A special-occasion cup with an elegant, mild-to-medium cigar (Davidoff, milder Cohiba), no milk.

cigarHint.hr: Borovnica i vino rade kao kontrast uz kratki, začinski Habano, ne uz puni maduro.
cigarHint.en: Blueberry and wine work as contrast with a short, spicy Habano, not a full maduro.

notes.hr: Sidamo ili Guji, sušena trešnja: borovnica, vino, cvijet, više tijela nego oprana Yirgacheffe. Voćni kontrast uz začinski Habano kratkog formata. Puna maduro cigara pretvara voće u džem i gubi čistoću.
notes.en: Sidamo or Guji, dried in cherry: blueberry, wine, flower, more body than washed Yirgacheffe. A fruit contrast with a spicy short Habano. A full maduro turns the fruit to jam and loses cleanliness.

cigarHint.hr: Duga šalica, duga cigara: spor ritam, kakao i zemlja uz punije tijelo.
cigarHint.en: Long cup, long cigar: a slow pace, cocoa and earth with fuller body.

notes.hr: Tamna mješavina, četiri minute u preši, talog u šalici. Puna tekstura, kakao i zemlja, niska kiselost. Duga šalica za dugu cigaru; ritam je sporiji nego kod espressa, pa se dim i gutljaj lakše izmjenjuju.
notes.en: Dark blend, four minutes in the press, sediment in the cup. Full texture, cocoa and earth, low acidity. A long cup for a long cigar; the pace is slower than espresso, so smoke and sip trade places more easily.

cigarHint.hr: Ljetni most uz srednju cigaru; čuvaj gustoću, ne razvodni ledom do vode.
cigarHint.en: A summer bridge with a medium cigar; keep the density, do not water it down with ice.

notes.hr: Hladna ekstrakcija 12–24 sata: niska kiselost, čokoladna glatkoća, srednje tijelo. Ljetna terasa uz srednju cigaru. Led ne smije rastopiti šalicu do vode; gustoća mora ostati, inače dim ostaje sam.
notes.en: Cold extraction 12–24 hours: low acidity, chocolate smoothness, medium body. A summer terrace with a medium cigar. Ice must not melt the cup to water; density has to stay, or the smoke is left alone.

cigarHint.hr: Mlijeko omekšava papar uz Connecticut; maduro se gubi u pjeni.
cigarHint.en: Milk softens pepper with Connecticut; maduro disappears in the foam.

notes.hr: Espresso plus mlijeko i pjena. Mlijeko omekšava papar i nikotin, ali pokriva cvjetne i mineralne note. Jutarnji spoj uz Connecticut ili blagi natural; Habano još prolazi, maduro se gubi u pjeni.
notes.en: Espresso plus milk and foam. Milk softens pepper and nicotine, but covers floral and mineral notes. A morning match with Connecticut or a mild natural; Habano still passes, maduro disappears in the foam.

cigarHint.hr: Kap mlijeka skida gorčinu, a šalica i dalje nosi srednju do punu cigaru.
cigarHint.en: A dash of milk takes the bitterness off, and the cup still carries a medium to full cigar.

notes.hr: Espresso označen kapi mlijeka: snaga šalice ostaje, gorčina se malo skine. Kompromis između čistog espressa i cappuccina. Srednja do puna cigara i dalje drži ritam; cvjetni filter ovdje nema smisla.
notes.en: Espresso marked with a dash of milk: the cup's power stays, bitterness eases a little. A compromise between straight espresso and cappuccino. A medium to full cigar still keeps pace; a floral filter has no business here.

cigarHint.hr: Viski i šlag traže srednju cigaru poslije jela; jutarnji Connecticut utone.
cigarHint.en: Whiskey and cream want a medium cigar after a meal; a morning Connecticut sinks.

notes.hr: Topla kava, irski viski, šećer i šlag. Dva mosta u jednoj čaši: prženje i žestica. Traži srednju cigaru poslije jela; Connecticut utone, a najjači maduro pretvara slatkoću u ljepilo.
notes.en: Hot coffee, Irish whiskey, sugar and cream. Two bridges in one glass: roast and spirit. It wants a medium cigar after a meal; Connecticut sinks, and the strongest maduro turns the sweetness to glue.

cigarHint.hr: Mali gutljaj žestice uz srednju do punu cigaru; slatki liker uz Shade nema strukture.
cigarHint.en: A small sip of spirit with a medium to full cigar; sweet liqueur with Shade has no structure.

notes.hr: Espresso 'popravljen' žesticom (Licor 43, brandy ili rum). Mediteranski nered koji radi kad je gutljaj mali. Srednja do puna cigara; slatki liker uz Shade pretvara dim u desert bez strukture.
notes.en: Espresso 'corrected' with spirit (Licor 43, brandy or rum). A Mediterranean mess that works when the sip is small. Medium to full cigar; a sweet liqueur with Shade turns the smoke into dessert without structure.

cigarHint.hr: Večernja cigara bez kofeina; biraj po tijelu šalice, ne po 'decaf' stigmi.
cigarHint.en: An evening cigar without caffeine; choose by the cup's body, not by a 'decaf' stigma.

notes.hr: Kolumbijski EA / sugarcane decaf, srednje prženje. Kofein je skinut, karamela i kakao ostaju dovoljno čitki. Večernja cigara kad ne želiš drugi espresso; sparivanje prati tijelo, ne kofein.
notes.en: Colombian EA / sugarcane decaf, medium roast. Caffeine is gone; caramel and cocoa stay readable enough. An evening cigar when you do not want a second espresso; pairing follows body, not caffeine.

cigarHint.hr: Šećer u cremi lijepi kratku maduro ili cuban-style cigaru; Connecticut postaje bombon.
cigarHint.en: Sugar in the crema glues a short maduro or Cuban-style cigar; Connecticut becomes candy.

notes.hr: Espresso u kojem se demerara ubije u cremu: gorčina i šećer u istoj šalici. Kubanska navika uz kratku, zemljanu cigaru. Šećer lijepi zadnju trećinu madura; Connecticut postaje bombon.
notes.en: Espresso with demerara beaten into the crema: bitterness and sugar in the same cup. A Cuban habit with a short, earthy cigar. Sugar glues a maduro's final third; Connecticut becomes candy.

cigarHint.hr: Čokolada i orah mirno prate srednju Connecticut ili Habano cigaru.
cigarHint.en: Chocolate and nut calmly follow a medium Connecticut or Habano.

notes.hr: Kratka, čista ekstrakcija brazilskog zrna: kakao, orah, karamela, srednje tijelo. Mirniji od espressa, gušći od V60. Most uz srednju Connecticut ili Habano cigaru; nema što vrišti ni s jedne strane.
notes.en: Short, clean extraction of a Brazilian bean: cocoa, nut, caramel, medium body. Calmer than espresso, denser than V60. A bridge with a medium Connecticut or Habano; nothing shouts on either side.

cigarHint.hr: Sočna kiselost voli Cameroon ili kratki Habano; puna nikaragvanska pregazi voće.
cigarHint.en: Juicy acidity likes Cameroon or a short Habano; a full Nicaraguan overruns the fruit.

notes.hr: Oprani Kayanza: ribiz, crvena jabuka, sočna kiselost, lagano tijelo. Svjež kontrast uz Cameroon ili kraći Habano. Geisha-tanka cigara radi; puna nikaragvanska pregazi voće u jednom dimu.
notes.en: Washed Kayanza: currant, red apple, juicy acidity, light body. A fresh contrast with Cameroon or a shorter Habano. A Geisha-thin cigar works; a full Nicaraguan overruns the fruit in one puff.

cigarHint.hr: Med i citrus uz laganu cigaru ujutro; maduro ostavi za tamniju šalicu.
cigarHint.en: Honey and citrus with a light morning cigar; leave maduro for a darker cup.

notes.hr: Honey (pulp natural) obrada: više slatkoće i tijela nego oprana, manje fermenta nego natural. Citrus i med, čisto lagano tijelo. Uz laganu cigaru ujutro; peaty i maduro ekstrem ostaju za drugi čin.
notes.en: Honey (pulp-natural) process: more sweetness and body than washed, less ferment than natural. Citrus and honey, clean light body. With a light cigar in the morning; peaty and maduro extremes wait for a later act.

cigarHint.hr: Samo najblaži Connecticut; jača cigara ovu šalicu obriše, ne 'ne paše'.
cigarHint.en: Only the mildest Connecticut; a stronger cigar wipes this cup out, it does not merely 'mismatch'.

notes.hr: Bergamot, jasmin, čajno tijelo; oprana, visoka nadmorska visina, svijetlo prženje. Najdelikatnija šalica u katalogu. Samo uz najblaži Connecticut. Jaka cigara ne 'ne paše' — ona ovu kavu obriše.
notes.en: Bergamot, jasmine, tea-like body; washed, high altitude, light roast. The most delicate cup in the catalogue. Only with the mildest Connecticut. A strong cigar does not 'mismatch' — it wipes this coffee out.

cigarHint.hr: Gusti kakao i začin vole maduro; svijetlo prženje ovdje nema partnera.
cigarHint.en: Dense cocoa and spice like maduro; a light roast has no partner here.

notes.hr: Prirodna (sušena) jemenska mocha: gusto tijelo, kakao, suho voće, začin, dašak dima. Stari trgovački profil, ne specialty moda. Most uz maduro i tamne note; filter-light partner ovdje nema što tražiti.
notes.en: Natural (dried) Yemeni mocha: dense body, cocoa, dried fruit, spice, a whiff of smoke. An old trade profile, not specialty fashion. A bridge with maduro and dark notes; a filter-light partner has no business here.

cigarHint.hr: Pepeo i gorčina dulje ekstrakcije vole srednju cigaru, ne njezni Shade.
cigarHint.en: Ash and bitterness from a longer extraction like a medium cigar, not delicate Shade.

notes.hr: Dulji espresso (60–90 ml): više vode kroz istu kavu, često više gorčine i pepela jer ekstrakcija predugo traje. Srednja cigara još drži; njezni Shade i ovaj pepeo se zbrajaju na krivu stranu.
notes.en: Longer espresso (60–90 ml): more water through the same coffee, often more bitterness and ash because extraction runs too long. A medium cigar still holds; delicate Shade and this ash add up the wrong way.

cigarHint.hr: Srednji TDS olakšava ritam uz srednju cigaru; skinuta crema drži šalicu čistom.
cigarHint.en: Medium TDS eases the pace with a medium cigar; skimmed crema keeps the cup clean.

notes.hr: Espresso razrijeđen vrućom vodom: srednji TDS, blaži ulaz, lakše ritmirati s dimom. Crema u vodi zna gorko sjesti; skinuta crema daje čišću šalicu. Svestran uz srednje cigare, bez težine doppia.
notes.en: Espresso diluted with hot water: medium TDS, softer entry, easier to pace with smoke. Crema in the water can sit bitter; skimmed crema gives a cleaner cup. Versatile with medium cigars, without a doppio's weight.

cigarHint.hr: Malo mlijeka uz blagu do srednju cigaru poslijepodne; manje skriva od cappuccina.
cigarHint.en: A little milk with a mild to medium afternoon cigar; it hides less than a cappuccino.

notes.hr: Jednaki dijelovi espressa i toplo mlijeko, bez velike pjene. Gorčina se skine, kakao ostaje. Poslijepodne uz blagu do srednju cigaru; manje skriva note od cappuccina, manje udara od čistog espressa.
notes.en: Equal parts espresso and warm milk, little foam. Bitterness eases, cocoa stays. Afternoon with a mild to medium cigar; it hides less than a cappuccino and hits less than straight espresso.

cigarHint.hr: Više kave nego cappuccino: Connecticut ili blagi natural; maduro vidi zavjesu.
cigarHint.en: More coffee than a cappuccino: Connecticut or a mild natural; maduro sees a curtain.

notes.hr: Doppio pod tankom mikro-pjenom: više kave nego cappuccino, manje mlijeka nego latte. Kremasti most uz Connecticut ili blagi natural. Maduro i dalje vidi mlijeko kao zavjesu.
notes.en: Doppio under a thin microfoam: more coffee than a cappuccino, less milk than a latte. A creamy bridge with Connecticut or a mild natural. Maduro still sees the milk as a curtain.

name: Vijetnamska ledena kava (cà phê sữa đá)

nameLoc.hr: Vijetnamska ledena kava (cà phê sữa đá)
nameLoc.en: Vietnamese iced coffee (cà phê sữa đá)

cigarHint.hr: Slatki hladni kontrast uz kratku, začinsku cigaru; dugi format se lijepi.
cigarHint.en: A sweet cold contrast with a short, spicy cigar; a long format sticks.

notes.hr: Phin kava, često robusta, s kondenziranim mlijekom i ledom. Gust, sladak, hladan profil niske kiselosti. Kontrast uz kratku, začinsku cigaru na vrućini; dugi Churchill i ova slatkoća se lijepe.
notes.en: Phin coffee, often robusta, with condensed milk and ice. Dense, sweet, cold, low acidity. Contrast with a short, spicy cigar in the heat; a long Churchill and this sweetness stick together.

cigarHint.hr: Konjak u šalici traži srednju do punu cigaru nakon jela, ne jutarnji Shade.
cigarHint.en: Cognac in the cup wants a medium to full cigar after a meal, not a morning Shade.

notes.hr: Espresso s 10–15 ml VSOP konjaka u istoj šalici. Kakao, hrast i karamela iz oba sastojka. Dvostruki most uz srednju do punu cigaru nakon jela; jutarnji Connecticut ovdje nema što tražiti.
notes.en: Espresso with 10–15 ml VSOP cognac in the same cup. Cocoa, oak and caramel from both parts. A double bridge with a medium to full cigar after a meal; a morning Connecticut has no business here.

cigarHint.hr: Jednostavan most uz srednju cigaru dok je kava vruća i nije prekuhana.
cigarHint.en: A simple bridge with a medium cigar while the coffee is hot and not stewed.

notes.hr: Uredska ili barske tamna filter kava, veći volumen. Kakao, dim, gorčina, niska kiselost. Pouzdan, neuzbudljiv most uz srednju cigaru. Nije specialty; radi dok je vruća i nije prekuhana.
notes.en: Office or bar dark filter coffee, larger volume. Cocoa, smoke, bitterness, low acidity. A reliable, unexciting bridge with a medium cigar. Not specialty; it works while hot and not stewed.

serving.best: Džezva: 2 žličice na 100 ml, do pjene, 3–5 min

cigarHint.hr: Čokolada i gustoća džezve nose srednju do punu cigaru s kakaom; Connecticut ostaje tanak uz Ciglicu.
cigarHint.en: Chocolate and cezve density carry a medium-to-full cocoa cigar; Connecticut stays thin beside the Ciglica.

notes.hr: Zagrebačka Ciglica: Franck miješa arabicu i robustu iz Srednje i Južne Amerike i Azije. Kuća je zove kraljicom zbog punog čokoladnog okusa. Kuha se u džezvi — dvije žličice na sto mililitara, do pjene, pa tri do pet minuta stajanja. Gusta je i poznata; uz nju sjeda srednja do puna cigara s kakaom, ne Shade.
notes.en: Zagreb’s Ciglica: Franck blends arabica and robusta from Central and South America and Asia. The house calls it the queen for a full chocolate flavour. It is made in a cezve — two spoons per 100 ml, heated to foam, then left three to five minutes. Dense and familiar; it sits with a medium-to-full cocoa cigar, not Shade.

cigarHint.hr: Pjena i kakao vole srednju Habano cigaru; šećer u džezvi lijepi maduro, ne Shade.
cigarHint.en: Foam and cocoa like a medium Habano; sugar in the pot glues maduro, not Shade.

notes.hr: Franck Crema je najfinije mljevena turska kava: bogata pjena i kremaste note čokolade i kakaovca. Kuha se u džezvi ili se prelije vrućom vodom. Nije 3-u-1 s mlijekom i šećerom — to je drugi proizvod. Uz čistu Cremu ide srednja Habano cigara; zaslađena u loncu podnosi i maduro.
notes.en: Franck Crema is finest-ground Turkish coffee: rich foam and creamy chocolate and cocoa notes. Brew it in a cezve or pour over with hot water. It is not the 3-in-1 with milk and sugar — that is a different SKU. Straight Crema wants a medium Habano; sweetened in the pot it can carry maduro.

cigarHint.hr: Karamela i lješnjak prate srednju Habano cigaru; maduro je težak za ovo voće.
cigarHint.en: Caramel and hazelnut follow a medium Habano; maduro is heavy for this fruit.

notes.hr: Franckov vakuumirani espresso za kućni aparat: svilenkasta tekstura, crema, karamela, lješnjak i blago voće. Kuća ga drži za cijeli dan, ne samo za jutarnji shot. Ide uz srednju Habano cigaru dok je šalica vruća.
notes.en: Franck’s vacuum-packed espresso for a home machine: silky texture, crema, caramel, hazelnut and mild fruit. The house presents it for the whole day, not only a morning shot. It suits a medium Habano while the cup is hot.

cigarHint.hr: Jasmin i karamela traže srednju, ne pretešku cigaru; maduro pregazi cvijet.
cigarHint.en: Jasmine and caramel want a medium cigar, not a heavy one; maduro drowns the flower.

notes.hr: illy Classico je ista 100 % arabica mješavina (devet podrijetla), srednje pržena. Kuća navodi gladak, baršunast okus s karamelom, narančinim cvijetom i jasminom te slatkast aftertaste. Nema gorčine barske robuste. Uz nju ostaje srednja Habano ili Cameroon cigara; maduro je pretežak.
notes.en: illy Classico is the same 100% arabica blend (nine origins), medium roast. The house cites a smooth, velvety cup with caramel, orange blossom and jasmine and a sweet aftertaste. It lacks bar-robusta bitterness. It keeps a medium Habano or Cameroon; maduro is too heavy.

cigarHint.hr: Kakao i tamnije prženje nose puniju Habano ili maduro cigaru; Connecticut ostaje ispod šalice.
cigarHint.en: Cocoa and the darker roast carry a fuller Habano or maduro; Connecticut sits under the cup.

notes.hr: Ista illyeva 100 % arabica, dulje pržena do tamnog profila Intenso. Službeno: aromatičan okus, kakao i suho voće, pun aftertaste. Nema robuste, pa gorčina dolazi od prženja, ne od vrste. Nosi puniju Habano i maduro cigaru bolje nego Classico.
notes.en: The same illy 100% arabica, roasted longer to the dark Intenso profile. Official: aromatic cup, cocoa and dried fruit, full aftertaste. No robusta, so bitterness comes from roast, not species. It carries a fuller Habano and maduro better than Classico.

cigarHint.hr: Čokolada i tijelo nose srednju do punu Habano cigaru; Shade uz Rossa ostaje tanak.
cigarHint.en: Chocolate and body carry a medium-to-full Habano; Shade stays thin beside Rossa.

notes.hr: Lavazza Qualità Rossa: uglavnom brazilska arabica i afrička robusta, srednje prženje, intenzitet 5/10. Kuća je opisuje kao tamnu, baršunastu, s notom čokolade — punog tijela, bez objavljenog omjera zrna. Radi u espressu i moki. Uz nju ide srednja do puna Habano cigara, ne Connecticut.
notes.en: Lavazza Qualità Rossa: mainly Brazilian arabica and African robustas, medium roast, intensity 5/10. The house calls it dark-coloured and velvety, with chocolate — full body, no published bean ratio. It works as espresso or moka. It wants a medium-to-full Habano, not Connecticut.

cigarHint.hr: Cvijet i voće prate lakšu do srednju Habano cigaru; maduro pregazi Orov profil.
cigarHint.en: Flower and fruit follow a lighter-to-medium Habano; maduro overruns Oro’s profile.

notes.hr: Lavazza Qualità Oro je 100 % arabica iz Srednje i Južne Amerike, srednje pržena, intenzitet 5/10. Službeno: baršunasto tijelo, cvjetne i voćne note. Nema robuste, pa je mekša od Rosse. Uz nju ostaje lakša do srednja Habano cigara; maduro je pretežak.
notes.en: Lavazza Qualità Oro is 100% arabica from Central and South America, medium roast, intensity 5/10. Official: velvety body, floral and fruity notes. No robusta, so it is softer than Rossa. It keeps a lighter-to-medium Habano; maduro is too heavy.

cigarHint.hr: Tamna čokolada i prženi orašasti most prema srednjoj Habano cigari; voće drži maduro podalje.
cigarHint.en: Dark chocolate and roasted nuts bridge to a medium Habano; the fruit keeps maduro at bay.

notes.hr: Julius Meinl Vienna Line Espresso: 100 % arabica, srednje prženje (na njihovoj ljestvici 4, srednje do tamno). Kuća navodi tamnu čokoladu i pržene orašaste, puno tijelo, slatko i voćno. Nije talijanska robusta-mješavina. Ide uz srednju Habano cigaru; maduro lako pregazi voće.
notes.en: Julius Meinl Vienna Line Espresso: 100% arabica, medium roast (their scale 4, medium to dark). The house cites dark chocolate and roasted nuts, full body, sweet and fruity. It is not an Italian robusta blend. It suits a medium Habano; maduro easily overruns the fruit.

cigarHint.hr: Tamno prženje i robusta nose punu Habano ili maduro cigaru; Connecticut nestaje uz Intermezzo.
cigarHint.en: Dark roast and robusta carry a full Habano or maduro; Connecticut vanishes beside Intermezzo.

notes.hr: Segafredo Intermezzo je tamno pržena mješavina s robustom: visok intenzitet, badem, čokolada, suho voće i začin. Kuća je namijenjuje espressu i moki. Gusta je i jutarnja; uz nju ide puna Habano ili maduro cigara, ne Shade.
notes.en: Segafredo Intermezzo is a dark-roast blend with robusta: high intensity, almond, chocolate, dried fruit and spice. The house points it at espresso and moka. Dense and morning-like; it wants a full Habano or maduro, not Shade.

name: Franck Jubilarna Intense
region: Srednja i Južna Amerika, Afrika, Azija (blend)

serving.best: Džezva: 2 žličice na 100 ml, do pjene, 3–5 min

cigarHint.hr: Tamna čokolada i slatki začin nose punu Habano ili maduro cigaru; Connecticut uz Intense ostaje tanak.
cigarHint.en: Dark chocolate and sweet spice carry a full Habano or maduro; Connecticut stays thin beside Intense.

notes.hr: Franckova Ciglica u tamnijem ruhu: arabica i robusta iz Srednje i Južne Amerike, Afrike i Azije. Kuća navodi tamnu čokoladu i slatke začine, intenzitet 4,5 od 5. Kuha se u džezvi kao Original. Gusta je i jutarnja; uz nju ide puna Habano ili maduro cigara, ne Shade.
notes.en: Franck’s Ciglica in a darker cut: arabica and robusta from Central and South America, Africa and Asia. The house cites dark chocolate and sweet spices, intensity 4.5 of 5. Brewed in a cezve like Original. Dense and morning-like; it wants a full Habano or maduro, not Shade.

serving.best: Džezva: 2 žličice na 100 ml, do pjene, 3–5 min

cigarHint.hr: Mliječna čokolada i lješnjak prate srednju Habano cigaru; maduro pregazi ovu nježniju Ciglicu.
cigarHint.en: Milk chocolate and hazelnut follow a medium Habano; maduro overruns this gentler Ciglica.

notes.hr: Mekša sestra Originala: arabica i robusta, baršunast okus, mliječna čokolada i lješnjak. Franck joj daje intenzitet 3,5 od 5. Nije 3-u-1 s mlijekom — čokolada je u zrnu. Kuha se u džezvi. Uz nju ostaje srednja Habano cigara; maduro je pretežak.
notes.en: The softer sister of Original: arabica and robusta, a velvety cup, milk chocolate and hazelnut. Franck rates it 3.5 of 5. It is not a 3-in-1 with milk — the chocolate is in the bean. Brewed in a cezve. It keeps a medium Habano; maduro is too heavy.

cigarHint.hr: Tamna čokolada i gusta crema nose punu Habano ili maduro cigaru; Connecticut nestaje uz Bonus.
cigarHint.en: Dark chocolate and thick crema carry a full Habano or maduro; Connecticut vanishes beside Bonus.

notes.hr: Franckov ugostiteljski espresso u zrnu: Južna Amerika i Azija, intenzitet 8,5 od 10. Kuća ističe tamnu čokoladu i bogatu, postojanu pjenu. Nije supermarketska Ciglica — ide na aparat, 25–30 ml. Uz nju sjeda puna Habano ili maduro cigara, ne Shade.
notes.en: Franck’s food-service espresso beans: South America and Asia, intensity 8.5 of 10. The house highlights dark chocolate and a rich, lasting crema. It is not the supermarket Ciglica — it belongs on a machine, 25–30 ml. It sits with a full Habano or maduro, not Shade.

cigarHint.hr: Ravna gorčina drži blagu cigaru na toploj podlozi; puna Habano ostaje sama.
cigarHint.en: Flat bitterness holds a mild cigar on a warm base; a full Habano sits alone.

notes.hr: Sušeni ekstrakt, uglavnom robusta: ravna gorčina bez arome svježe kave. Uz cigaru radi kao topla neutralna podloga — ne pojačava ništa, ali ni ne smeta blažem dimu. Kad je izbor između instanta i ničega, uzmi manje šećera i više vode.
notes.en: Dried extract, mostly robusta: flat bitterness without fresh-coffee aroma. With a cigar it works as a warm neutral base — it lifts nothing, but does not fight a milder smoke either. When the choice is instant or nothing, take less sugar and more water.

cigarHint.hr: Šećer i prah prekrivaju dim; uz 3-u-1 radije drži vodu, ne cigaru.
cigarHint.en: Sugar and powder blanket the smoke; with 3-in-1 keep water, not a cigar.

notes.hr: Šećer i mliječni prah prekrivaju i zrno i cigaru — fine note nestanu, ostaje slatkoća. Uz blagu cigaru guši sve što bi se imalo osjetiti; ako je to jedino pri ruci, radije popij vodu uz dim.
notes.en: Sugar and milk powder blanket both the bean and the cigar — fine notes vanish and only sweetness remains. With a mild cigar it drowns everything worth tasting; if it is all you have, drink water alongside the smoke instead.
